response.effect: +24.7 pp vs its twin after month 6
response.reason: A blend of peers (TRN-05, TRN-01, HLT-01, GOV-06, PWR-01) matched this entity's monthly share of likely-superficial cases for six months (error 0.0 pp). Afterwards the entity ran +24.7 pp from its twin, larger than 98% of the same gaps computed for every peer (placebo test).
response.name: Divergence from its synthetic twin
response.method: Synthetic control (Abadie et al. 2010): a weighted blend of peers that tracks the entity's monthly share of likely-superficial cases in the first half-year; the post-period gap is ranked against placebo twins of every peer
regulations: SEBI CSCRF - SOC functional efficacy (sustained performance)
